packet: existing observation_schema_version 1, embedded scene-v1, unique ids, strict finite JSON numbers
initial_policy: reject on-plane or unresolved-side launch; no fabricated initial hit
max_step_s: finite positive; duration/10000 <= max_step_s <= duration; halved step must be representable
min_normal_speed_m_s: finite positive threshold; |normal velocity| must exceed it

accuracy.scope: time, position and velocity; position_atol also bounds absolute plane residual and coordinate uncertainty
accuracy.not: solver accuracy input, guaranteed global error, or first-root completeness proof

reuse: packet-local exact validated event-request cache; separate from saved-state runs
no_event: no root detected in both successful searches; NOT proof of absence or no tangency

exit_codes.0: all results ok/no_event and old optional checks pass; or schema-only validation
exit_codes.1: one or more local failures / failed old checks; full report retained

detection_limits: multiple roots per step may be missed
two refinements do not prove completeness
tangencies and zero-normal-speed crossings not qualified
terminal search is not collision protection
schema_note: Descriptive contract, not JSON Schema; runtime parser authoritative.
